SERIES SPOTLIGHT

Andrei Tarkovsky Retrospective

We pay tribute to the visionary, poetic cinema of Andrei Tarkovsky with a seven-film retrospective from his debut feature IVAN'S CHILDHOOD on 35mm to his haunting final masterpiece THE SACRIFICE. August 29–September 30.
